'''Roz''' was a [[free-trader]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was hired by [[Almera Zan]] to transport her group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to [[Demophon]], searching for [[Enid Vahr]]. His ship was destroyed, and only he, Almera Zan, [[Tamarc]], and [[Grashk]] survived. Roz was later shot while stranded on Demophon.<ref name="BE" />
